name: How to Redact a PDF
description: Permanently cover sensitive areas in a PDF — 100% local, nothing uploaded.

step.name: Open your PDF
step.text: Click 'Choose files' or drag your PDF into the drop zone.

step.name: Draw redaction boxes
step.text: Click and drag over any area you want to cover. A black opaque box covers the selected region permanently.

step.name: Download the redacted PDF
step.text: Click 'Redact PDF'. The covered areas are baked into the page — they cannot be uncovered in any PDF viewer.
